module.name: Medical Report
module.author: CERIST / CHU Blida neurosurgery integration
module.description: Medical report generation. Owns per-image observation reports over Orthanc DICOM studies (versioned, audited, soft-deleted) and personalised full patient reports assembled from any module that announces clinical data.

privilege.name: App: medreport.imaging.view
privilege.description: Read imaging observation reports - one's own and other authors' - and download their documents. Assign to surgeons, OR nurses and radiologists/technicians.

privilege.name: App: medreport.imaging.manage
privilege.description: Write imaging observation reports, and edit or remove one's OWN reports. Never grants access to another author's report. Assign to surgeons and radiologists/technicians, together with the view privilege.

privilege.name: App: medreport.admin
privilege.description: Browse a report's full version history and restore a removed report. Everyone else, the report's own author included, sees only the current version. Assign to system administrators / the department head only.

privilege.name: App: medreport.dashboardGenerate
privilege.description: Generate a personalised full patient report from the patient dashboard. What the report may contain is further limited by the privileges the user holds over each individual set of clinical data.

privilege.name: Manage Medical Reports
privilege.description: API-level: create and update medical reports

globalProperty.description: Base URL of the Report Generation Service. Must be reachable from the OpenMRS container on the private network; it should NOT be published on the hospital LAN.

Shared token presented to the Report Generation Service. Must equal that service's MEDREPORT_RGS_TOKEN. Empty means report rendering is disabled and every attempt fails with a configuration message rather than silently.
How long to wait for a render before giving up (minimum 5).
Default report language: fr, en or ar.
Template profile pre-selected in the personalisation window.
Template profile used for per-image observation reports.
Facility name printed in report headers.
Department name printed in report headers.
Complex-datatype concept the rendered report document is stored against. Created automatically on first start.
Encounter type imaging reports are filed under. Created automatically on first start; reports still work without it, filed against the patient only.
